blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Thirteen local government units (LGUs) in Bukidnon received gold awards during the 26th Gawad Kalasag National and Regional Awarding ceremony on Tuesday, Nov. 24, in Cagayan de Oro City, giving the province the most top awardees in Northern Mindanao (Region 10). Data from the Office of Civil Defense (OCD) Region 10 showed that 81 of the region’s 98 LGUs passed validation. Of these, 32 received gold, 30 silver, and 19 bronze awards. Sixteen LGUs failed to pass validation, while one did not submit documents for verification. The 13 Bukidnon gold awardees are Malaybalay City, Valencia City, Cabanglasan, […]...
